For an Enterprise tier customer, the guaranteed initial response time for a Severity 1 (Critical) incident is ≤ 30 minutes, available 24/7/365. This coverage is provided through the Enterprise Tier's 24/7/365 dedicated telephone hotline and priority support channels. The Professional tier offers ≤ 2 hours (24/7/365) for Severity 1 incidents, but Enterprise tier provides the more aggressive 30-minute guarantee. Starter tier receives no SLA coverage for Severity 1 incidents (Community Support, No SLA). The policy defines initial response time as the duration between ticket creation and the first substantive technical response by a qualified CloudScale support engineer. Enterprise customers also receive status updates every 30 minutes during ongoing Severity 1 incidents.

Supporting citations:
- [DOC-SLA-2024-V2, p. 4, section 5.2 Response Time Matrix] – Table 3 shows Enterprise Tier ≤ 30 Minutes (24/7 Dedicated) for Severity 1.
- [DOC-SLA-2024-V2, p. 4, section 5.4 Support Access Channels by Subscription Tier] – Enterprise Tier includes 24/7/365 dedicated telephone hotline; Professional tier hours are Monday–Friday 08:00–20:00 US Eastern with 24/7 coverage exclusively for Severity 1.
- [DOC-SLA-2024-V2, p. 4, section 5.3 Ongoing Incident Communication Cadence] – Enterprise customers receive status updates every 30 minutes for Severity 1 incidents.
- [DOC-SLA-2024-V2, p. 1, section 2. Subscription Tiers] – Enterprise Tier description includes 24/7/365 priority hotline and Slack support.

Missing information: The policy does not specify a different initial response time guarantee for Enterprise tier incidents that occur outside of business hours vs. within business hours; the "24/7 Dedicated" phrasing implies around-the-clock coverage, but the exact calendar-day availability (including holidays) is not explicitly enumerated beyond "24/7/365". No conflicting wording was found.
missing_information: Exact holiday coverage clarification beyond the 24/7/365 statement
Whether the 30-minute guarantee applies to all Severity 1 incidents regardless of incident origin or customer contract specifics
